source_summary: Ink painting dominated by a bare plum-like tree form on warm silk, with thick wet-wash trunk at the right, angular leafless branches extending across the center and lower half, and a faint horizontal atmospheric wash. Red seals and small inscription are excluded.

motifs.name: right_curved_trunk
motifs.description: Isolate the thick dark trunk mass along the right edge, including the curved swollen section, forked bend, and wet ink transitions from dark outer contour to pale interior wash.
must_preserve: soft diluted ink wash inside the trunk
knotted swelling at the central bend

motifs.name: upper_forking_branches
motifs.description: Isolate the high network of thin bare branches emerging from the upper right trunk and crossing diagonally through the top center, without seals or border areas.

motifs.name: right_vertical_twig_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the slender upright twig cluster just right of the main trunk, including the narrow vertical shoots and small angled offshoots.

motifs.name: central_rising_branch
motifs.description: Isolate the central leafless branch rising from the lower crossing point toward the upper left, with its angled joints and small side twigs.
must_preserve: slender taper from base to tip

motifs.name: long_left_sweeping_branch
motifs.description: Isolate the long, low horizontal branch sweeping from the central junction toward the left, including its sparse upward and downward twigs.

motifs.name: lower_right_diagonal_branch
motifs.description: Isolate the darker diagonal branch descending from the central junction to the lower right edge; exclude the nearby black inscription characters.
must_preserve: taper toward the lower right edge

motifs.name: lower_right_horizontal_shoot
motifs.description: Isolate the thin nearly horizontal shoot extending across the lower right area, separate from the red seal below and the inscription above.

motifs.name: central_mist_wash_band
motifs.description: Isolate the faint horizontal gray-green atmospheric wash band behind the branches across the middle of the image, keeping only the soft tonal field and not the paper texture, seals, or branches.

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
